open scoped NNReal RealInnerProductSpace
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
definition_context: SupportsAt f x g means ∀ y:E, f x + ⟨g,y-x⟩ ≤ f y, with the real inner product. The quantifier ranges over the entire space, not a constraint subset.

LipschitzWith G f means dist(f u,f v) ≤ G*dist(u,v) for all u,v. G:ℝ≥0 is a nonnegative real, coerced into ℝ in the conclusion. NormedAddCommGroup plus InnerProductSpace ℝ supplies the real norm and inner product; no completeness is specified.
cases.statement:
example {f : E → ℝ} {G : ℝ≥0} {x g : E}
    (hf : LipschitzWith G f) (hs : SupportsAt f x g) : ‖g‖ ≤ (G : ℝ)

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
noncomputable def heatBathSnd {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
    [StandardBorelSpace β] [Nonempty β] (μ : Measure (α × β)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    Kernel (α × β) (α × β) :=
  (Kernel.id ×ₖ condDistrib Prod.snd Prod.fst μ) ∘ₖ
    Kernel.deterministic Prod.fst measurable_fst
variable {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
  [StandardBorelSpace β] [Nonempty β]
definition_context: Measure X is a nonnegative extended-real measure. IsFiniteMeasure μ means μ(X)<∞ and permits μ=0. Kernel α β is a measurable assignment of measures on β; a Markov kernel has total mass one at every input.

Kernel.Invariant K μ means μ.bind K=μ. κ∘ₖη is kernel composition, κ∘ₘμ means μ.bind κ, and Kernel.deterministic f hf sends x to the Dirac measure at f(x). Kernel.id sends a to δ_a; ×ₖ is the product of two output kernels sharing an input.

condDistrib Prod.snd Prod.fst μ is a chosen regular conditional Markov kernel for the second coordinate given the first, for finite μ and nonempty standard-Borel β. Its disintegration/conditional meaning is characterized only almost everywhere for the first marginal; its selected normalization is pointwise. α has only a measurable-space assumption.
cases.statement:
example (μ : Measure (α × β)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    (heatBathSnd μ).Invariant μ
